name: Public International Law and IHL
seo_title: UGC NET Law Public International Law & IHL Notes (Unit 3)
description: UGC NET Law Public International Law & IHL notes: 11 topics, 66 sub-topics on sources, the UN, disputes, the WTO and IHL. Free, with revision mode.
intro: Public International Law and IHL is a scoring unit because the questions are factual and the same cases, treaties and Article numbers repeat. Topic 0 shows how the unit is tested. Topics 1 to 4 cover sources, recognition, nationality, refugees, extradition and asylum; Topics 5 to 7 cover the UN organs, dispute settlement and state responsibility, and the WTO; Topic 8 covers international humanitarian law. Topics 9 and 10 are revision: rapid tables of numbers, years and cases, then frequently confused pairs, mnemonics and a recent-developments radar.
how: Start with Topic 0, then read Topics 1 to 8 in order. For each topic learn the definition, the key Articles and years, three to five leading cases, the India angle and the recent development.

Switch on Revision mode on any topic page to keep each section's key terms, lists and tables. Then work through Topic 9 (numbers, years, case-to-principle) and Topic 10 (confusing pairs and mnemonics).
Use the rapid-recall sheet (numbers, years, case matches, WTO agreements), then the recent-developments radar in Topic 10, and practise MCQs.
